column3: The assignee and link pickers are a UI SDK Popover holding a Command rather than the Combobox the v2 migration table names
column4: A pick there is an action (one issue.update or issue.link) and the field keeps no selected value, so Combobox's value, restore-on-close and label-in-input fight it; Command gives the always-expanded list, auto-highlight and an action event, and pane.tsx's + view menu already uses Popover + Command
column5: e2e: typing then Enter sends one issue.update with the first assignee match, and a typed #id sends one issue.link with the chosen kind; a refused link keeps the popover open with the error
